title: Which player will command the highest transfer fee paid by a Premier League club during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: This question concerns completed transfers into Premier League clubs ahead of the 2026–27 season.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Resolve using Al Jazeera Sport's reporting of completed transfers after England's 2026 summer transfer window closes. The answer is the player whose transfer fee, expressed in pounds sterling, is the highest paid by a Premier League club during that window. Exclude proposed or failed transfers. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
